rowNotes.adj: GAAP minus core sales: yen/won hedge translation (constant-currency adj. thru Q1-26; hedged-exposure adj. from Q2-26).
rowNotes.gp: Core P&L history from GAAP-to-core reconciliations in each earnings release.
rowNotes.other: History = core pretax - core operating income. Projections are $ inputs.
rowNotes.nci: History = plug (pretax - taxes - net income); mostly Hemlock minority interest.
rowNotes.ni: 2021 includes the $24mm preferred dividend add-back used in diluted core EPS.
rowNotes.sh: Weighted diluted shares used for core EPS (earnings releases).
rowNotes.shG: 2027E +1.0% reflects the $2B ATM program (8-K 9/11/2026) and NVIDIA warrants.
rowNotes.afcf: Company adj. FCF = OCF + realized hedge gains - capex (2021-23 company figure also deducted FX translation on cash).
rowNotes.cx: Capacity build for Meta / Amazon / NVIDIA (3 new plants) keeps capex elevated through 2028.
rowNotes.nonc: Cash items excluded from core: hedge gap net of realized hedge gains, restructuring, litigation. H1'26 ~2.2%.
rowNotes.frac: Balance sheet is as of 6/30/2026, so only H2-2026 FCF is counted.
rowNotes.ebit: Stock-based comp is NOT added back (treated as a real cost).

methodology: Core = Corning's non-GAAP basis (what management guides to and consensus uses); GAAP history shown alongside.
Segments follow the 2026 structure; 2021-23 mapped from the old segments (see Model notes).
DCF: UFCF = (core EBIT - non-core cash costs) x (1 - tax) + depreciation - capex - increase in NWC; SBC treated as a cost; mid-period discounting from the valuation date.
